name: Johaan's Findings
summary: Apothecary Johaan sends his findings south from Brill to the Sepulcher. His research carries recent alchemical work from Tirisfal Glades to Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine Forest.

sections.title: Apothecary Correspondence
sections.body: Apothecary Johaan sends his research from Brill to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher. The Royal Apothecary Society works under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's demand for a New Plague that can destroy both the living and the Scourge. Its researchers are scattered across Lordaeron's contested ruins, so they must share their findings between outposts. Renferrel directs the Society's efforts from Silverpine Forest, while Johaan records his local tests in Brill. His documents join the Society's wider work to refine its deadly brews.

faq.answer: Johaan's Findings are alchemical notes and research compiled by Apothecary Johaan in Brill. They record his recent tests and experiments in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Who is supposed to receive this item?
aliases: where do i take johaans findings
faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel is meant to receive the findings. He is a senior member of the Royal Apothecary Society at the Sepulcher in northern Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why is this research being shared between apothecaries?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society shares knowledge among its scattered researchers to hasten their work. Sylvanas Windrunner demands swift progress on the New Plague, so researchers in Silverpine need to hear of discoveries made in Tirisfal.
Apothecary Johaan wrote the documents. He is a Royal Apothecary Society alchemist near the gallows in Brill, where he tests local specimens for Forsaken alchemical work.

angles.text: As an Undead, these findings speak to the Royal Apothecary Society's driving aim: delivering the New Plague promised to the Dark Lady.
As a member of the Horde, carrying research south takes you from familiar Tirisfal Glades into Silverpine Forest's darker conflicts.
